issues.failed-save-clears-text: On the plant detail page, when saving a new journal entry fails (POST /api/journal error), the error is shown but the typed entry text is cleared from the textarea.
issues.search-quote-crash: Searching the journal for a term containing an apostrophe (e.g. O'Brien) makes GET /api/journal?q= return 500 because the term is pasted into the SQL, and the Journal page shows only 'Could not load the journal.'
issues.journal-nav-hang-shows-old-page: Navigating to /journal while its API request hangs changes the URL but keeps the previous Plants page displayed with no loading indicator or error.
issues.detail-malformed-journal-shows-fake-entr: On the plant detail page, a malformed (non-list) GET /api/journal?plant_id= response is rendered as blank entries dated '–' with active Edit/Delete buttons instead of an error.
issues.journal-page-malformed-shows-fake-entrie: On the Journal page, a malformed (non-list, e.g. string) GET /api/journal response is rendered as an entry count and blank '–' cards instead of an error.
issues.journal-page-non-list-shown-as-no-match: On the Journal page, when the journal API returns an object instead of a list, the page shows '0 entries match' / 'No entries match' instead of an error.
issues.journal-nav-link-keeps-stale-search: On /journal with an active search, clicking the Journal nav link clears q from the URL but leaves the search box text and filtered results in place.
issues.add-entry-error-not-cleared: On the plant detail page, the error from a failed 'Add entry' save stays visible after the form is cleared and another journal action (such as editing an entry) succeeds.
issues.journal-search-hang-loading-forever: On the Journal page, when a search request hangs, the page shows 'Loading entries…' indefinitely above the previous search's results with no timeout, error or retry.
